properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The runtime hash provider (v12.0, 2022) underneath everything ethereum-cryptography re-exports to this wallet (keccak256, sha256, pbkdf2, scrypt, hdkey/BIP32 via @scure/bip32): SHA-2, SHA-3/keccak, BLAKE2/BLAKE3, RIPEMD, KDF support. Version 1.2.0 predates any post-quantum algorithm support entirely — that version pin is the headline fact this entry records for the CBOM.
